digest.component_or_area: metrics event-derivation readers over ticket event store
propositions: Read-only derivations over durable ticket event store must compute five agent-process metrics (attempts-per-ticket, first-pass verification rate, rework at 7/30 days, reopen-recovery, revert-linked recovery) with clean, verifiable event signatures.

Metrics requiring per-event or multi-occurrence data (attempts, rework windows, reopen counts) must read raw event files sorted via event_sort_key, including compaction-retired events via is_active_event, and reusing existing reducer helpers rather than reinventing file handling.

Metrics for which a single terminal value suffices (first_pass_rate via absence of last_reopened_at, revert_recovery via reverts[] list) must read compiled state from reduce_ticket to ensure correctness of terminal facts.

A metric over an empty date range must return None (Unavailable in registry), while a populated range with zero qualifying events must return 0 (measured zero) — both states are distinct and must be asserted.
Revert recovery must count only tickets whose reverts target STATUS or COMMITS events (substantive reverts), not COMMENT or LINK reverts, filtering by target_event_type.

Unit tests must verify that a two-session ticket yields attempts_per_ticket==2, a closed→open→closed 3-day gap counts in rework_within_days(7) but not 10-day gap, and retired events are still counted.
